$comment: D-LIR-NO-EXCEPTIONAL-EDGE-INTO-A-TRY-HANDLER: what a __try handler reads. Control reaches a handler through the system's unwinder, from any instruction of the guarded body, and the unwinder hands over the frame and the call-preserved registers and nothing else — so a value the handler (or the code after the region) reads must be in the frame or in a call-preserved register for the whole body. Twenty-two cases, each a function of its own: a parameter, a local, a double (the vector class), a global's shared address, a struct returned through the caller's result address, a struct parameter passed by reference, a pointer the handler passes on, a region inside a loop, two regions in sequence, a handler with branches, a stack-passed parameter, a fault inside a callee, an integer division by zero caught by name. Cases 27..32 are D-WIN64-XMM-UNWIND-RESTORE, the saved vector register: a double kept across a call inside and before a region, three doubles read by a handler, and a fault that unwinds THROUGH a callee which saved every call-preserved vector register and overwrote it (it keeps thirteen doubles across its own call, ten of them compared after it and never added: MEASURED 2026-10-12 on the images of both arms, each of the three callees saves xmm6..xmm15 and each caller keeps its double in xmm15 — a callee keeping one double was given a different register from its caller's and proved nothing, and one keeping thirteen as a sum saved nine and left xmm15 alone) — the handler then reads the guarding function's double only if the callee's unwind information says where it saved the register (once through a plain callee, once through a callee whose own call passes one argument on the stack — an odd count of outgoing stack slots, which used to put its register-save area 8 bytes off the multiple of 16 the unwind information requires — and once through a callee that guards a region of its own and declines the fault). The exit code names the first case to fail (11..32); 42 = all right. The reference compiler (cl 19.51 x64, /Od and /O2) runs this file to 42. The release arm is the same file through the optimizer, where a shared address or a value kept in a register across the body is the common case. ON A HOST THAT IS NOT WINDOWS this file is built and not run: `program/test_guarded_region_examples_on_every_host` builds both arms for pe64 on every host and holds that every region has its record, that no handler takes a value from a register a call does not preserve, and that the three callees save every vector register a call preserves.
